   The binary number has 11 digits, so we add one leading zero to make it 12 digits:

2. **Group the binary number into sets of three digits starting from the right.**

   \(010\ 101\ 001\ 110\).

3. **Convert each group of three binary digits to its corresponding octal digit.**  
   - \(010_2 = 2_8\)

   - \(001_2 = 1_8\)
